\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 209-212 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R217-first-pass-words-from-chapters-209-212}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a room and a stadium.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to borrow, to lend, to save up, to spend, to weigh
  \item to sign, to phone, to meet, to marry, to survive
  \item to shout, to get angry, to feel shy, to quarrel, to hug
  \item to compare, to rent, to swap, to fight, to run away
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To borrow? (\textbf{\bn{ধার} \bn{নেওয়া}}, \emph{dhār neoyā}.) To lend? (\textbf{\bn{ধার} \bn{দেওয়া}}, \emph{dhār deoyā}.) To save up? (\textbf{\bn{জমানো}}, \emph{jômāno}.) To spend? (\textbf{\bn{খরচ} \bn{করা}}, \emph{khôrôch kôrā}.) To weigh? (\textbf{\bn{ওজন} \bn{করা}}, \emph{ojôn kôrā}.) To sign? (\textbf{\bn{সই} \bn{করা}}, \emph{sôi kôrā}.) To phone? (\textbf{\bn{ফোন} \bn{করা}}, \emph{phon kôrā}.) To meet? (\textbf{\bn{দেখা} \bn{করা}}, \emph{dækhā kôrā}.) To marry? (\textbf{\bn{বিয়ে} \bn{করা}}, \emph{biye kôrā}.) To survive? (\textbf{\bn{বাঁচা}}, \emph{bā̃chā}.) To shout? (\textbf{\bn{চেঁচানো}}, \emph{chẽchāno}.) To get angry? (\textbf{\bn{রাগ} \bn{করা}}, \emph{rāg kôrā}.) To feel shy? (\textbf{\bn{লজ্জা} \bn{পাওয়া}}, \emph{lôjjā pāoyā}.) To quarrel? (\textbf{\bn{ঝগড়া} \bn{করা}}, \emph{jhôgṛā kôrā}.) To hug? (\textbf{\bn{জড়িয়ে} \bn{ধরা}}, \emph{jôṛiye dhôrā}.) To compare? (\textbf{\bn{তুলনা} \bn{করা}}, \emph{tulônā kôrā}.) To rent? (\textbf{\bn{ভাড়া} \bn{নেওয়া}}, \emph{bhāṛā neoyā}.) To swap? (\textbf{\bn{পাল্টানো}}, \emph{pālṭāno}.) To fight? (\textbf{\bn{লড়া}}, \emph{lôṛā}.) To run away? (\textbf{\bn{পালানো}}, \emph{pālāno}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 213-217 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R217-second-pass-words-from-chapters-213-217}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to have a haircut and to dress up.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to have a haircut, to dress up, to get ready, to set off, to ride
  \item to take a photo, to pass, to fail, to shake, to stir
  \item an ointment, a doctor's surgery, a patient, a pulse, breath
  \item a garage, beside, all around, above, somewhere
  \item a lake, a bus stand, an airport, a room, a stadium
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To have a haircut? (\textbf{\bn{চুল} \bn{কাটা}}, \emph{chul kāṭā}.) To dress up? (\textbf{\bn{সাজা}}, \emph{sājā}.) To get ready? (\textbf{\bn{প্রস্তুত} \bn{হওয়া}}, \emph{prôstut hôoyā}.) To set off? (\textbf{\bn{রওনা} \bn{দেওয়া}}, \emph{rôonā deoyā}.) To ride? (\textbf{\bn{চড়া}}, \emph{chôṛā}.) To take a photo? (\textbf{\bn{ছবি} \bn{তোলা}}, \emph{chhôbi tolā}.) To pass? (\textbf{\bn{পাস} \bn{করা}}, \emph{pās kôrā}.) To fail? (\textbf{\bn{ফেল} \bn{করা}}, \emph{phel kôrā}.) To shake? (\textbf{\bn{ঝাঁকানো}}, \emph{jhā̃kāno}.) To stir? (\textbf{\bn{নাড়ানো}}, \emph{nāṛāno}.) An ointment? (\textbf{\bn{মলম}}, \emph{môlôm}.) A doctor's surgery? (\textbf{\bn{ডাক্তারখানা}}, \emph{ḍāktārkhānā}.) A patient? (\textbf{\bn{রোগী}}, \emph{rogī}.) A pulse? (\textbf{\bn{নাড়ি}}, \emph{nāṛi}.) Breath? (\textbf{\bn{নিঃশ্বাস}}, \emph{niḥshvās}.) A garage? (\textbf{\bn{গ্যারেজ}}, \emph{gærej}.) Beside? (\textbf{\bn{পাশে}}, \emph{pāshe}.) All around? (\textbf{\bn{চারপাশে}}, \emph{chārpāshe}.) Above? (\textbf{\bn{ওপরে}}, \emph{opôre}.) Somewhere? (\textbf{\bn{কোথাও}}, \emph{kothāo}.) A lake? (\textbf{\bn{হ্রদ}}, \emph{hrôd}.) A bus stand? (\textbf{\bn{বাসস্ট্যান্ড}}, \emph{bāsṭænḍ}.) An airport? (\textbf{\bn{বিমানবন্দর}}, \emph{bimānbôndôr}.) A room? (\textbf{\bn{রুম}}, \emph{rum}.) A stadium? (\textbf{\bn{স্টেডিয়াম}}, \emph{sṭeḍiyām}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
